profile.bio: A general Instagram user who briefly stops on the faceless reel but distrusts unknown brands asking for payment before the product exists. Voices the objections of the scroll-past audience: no brand history, no visible product, a 3-4 week wait. Likely to comment doubts or simply move on, and sets the discovery drop-off.
profile.stance: Opposed for now - will not prepay an unknown brand; says wait until others have received and reviewed it, and treats the preorder trust gap as a reason to pass

memory.content: Rounds 1-10: Called out the preorder trust gap from the first hour, ran the numbers on what 100 prepaid units mean, and mocked the founder's 'proper post later' promises. Amplified doubt around the reseller rumour without claiming proof, then watched the collector lead commit.

Rounds 11-20: Mocked the collector lead's decision, watched shipping week with scepticism, and conceded 'it exists' once the first unboxing appeared. Kept attacking the missing growing method and absent care guidance.

Commented: 'Settled' means bloomed, and nothing has bloomed. Announce nothing until it does.

decision_log.blocker: pay before product exists, no brand history, no face

decision_log.reason: will not prepay a second time without bloom evidence and a refund policy
